title: The Reef Gets Two Years To Heal A Decade
hook: Bleaching now returns long before the Great Barrier Reef can recover.
closing: Each early return interrupts healing, turning repeated bleaching into cumulative damage.
question: Can the reef recover in time?

segments.say: The reef has bleached three times this decade. A rare shock has become a recurring event.
The average gap is now two years. New damage arrives before the last event fades.
A reef typically needs ten years to recover. Bleaching now returns far too soon for a full comeback.
